table.join: {{entity}} takes a seat at the table

reason.unknown-entity: that creature is not at the table
reason.unknown-mechanic: that action is not available to this creature
reason.not-your-turn: it is not that creature's turn
reason.unaffordable: there is nothing left to spend on it
reason.missing-answer: something still had to be chosen or rolled
reason.no-such-check: that check is no longer pending
reason.invalid-table-op: the table could not do that
reason.unknown-action: the action it refers to is gone
reason.invalid-target: that target is not a legal one
reason.invalid-roll: the roll does not add up
reason.roll-roller-mismatch: that roll belongs to another creature

view.zoomOutTip: Take in more of the map.
view.fitTip: Fit the whole map in the window again.
view.playerTip: See the map exactly as the players see it, fog and hidden tokens included.

tools.selectTip: Pick a creature, or drag your own token to move it.
tools.rulerTip: Drag across the map to measure a distance.
tools.rulerHint: Drag from one point to another.
tools.addTip: Put a creature from the bestiary on the map.
tools.fog-revealTip: Drag a rectangle to reveal it; tap again to switch to covering.
tools.fog-hideTip: Drag a rectangle to hide it from the players.

fog.title: Fog
fog.onNote: The map is covered; the players see only what you have revealed.
fog.offNote: There is no fog: the players see the whole map.
fog.opacityTip: How dark the fog looks to you. It changes nothing for the players.

economy.actionTip: One action per turn: an attack, a spell, a shove.
economy.bonusTip: Only some things cost one, and only one per turn.
economy.reactionTip: One per round, spent outside your own turn.

hotbar.hpTip: Open the editor to apply damage, healing, temporary hit points or a condition.

empty.common: Nothing to use from here yet.
empty.spells: This creature has no spell the table can resolve.
empty.items: No item on this creature does anything by itself.
empty.passive: Passive traits are always on; they live on the character sheet.
empty.mine: Pinned actions arrive with the sheet.

turn.endTip: Pass the turn to the next creature in the order.
turn.notYours: It is not this creature's turn.

dice.title: Dice
dice.tip: Switch between the app rolling and typing the faces of your own dice.

reaction.title: Open reactions
reaction.noneTip: Nothing is waiting on a reaction.

error.empty: There is no formula to roll.
error.syntax: That formula does not read as dice.
error.die-sides: That is not a die this game uses.
error.dice-count: That is not a number of dice.
error.too-many-dice: That is more dice than one roll can hold.
error.keep-count: Keeping that many dice is not possible.
error.flat-range: That flat number is out of range.
error.faces-count: The number of faces does not match the formula.
error.face-range: One of those faces is impossible on that die.
error.seed-missing: The roll is missing its seed.
error.seed-on-manual: A hand-entered roll carries no seed.

verdict.hitTip: The total reached the target's Armour Class.
verdict.critTip: A natural 20: the damage dice are rolled twice.
verdict.missTip: The total fell short of the target's Armour Class.
verdict.save-failTip: The saving throw did not reach the DC: the effect lands in full.
verdict.save-successTip: The saving throw reached the DC: half damage, or no effect.

drawer.title: DM board
drawer.openTip: Log, hidden things, fog and rules, in one panel that shifts the screen instead of covering it.
drawer.closeTip: Give the screen its full width back.
drawer.noTokens: Nobody is at the table yet.
drawer.monsterHpTip: Off, the players see only the bar.
drawer.hiddenRollsTip: On, your rolls reach the table as dice with no faces.
drawer.sceneEmpty: Scenes and maps arrive with the DM's preparation screen; this table has one map.
drawer.notesEmpty: DM notes arrive with the campaign journal.

rules.title: Automation
rules.full-autoTip: The app resolves everything and logs who did what.
rules.log-onlyTip: The app records what you tell it and applies nothing by itself.
rules.note: You can change this mid-session, and you can correct any outcome afterwards.

hp.hint: Correct the number and the log follows you.

pill.initiativeTip: The number this creature acts on. Enter it to place it in the order.
pill.hideTip: The players stop seeing this token; you keep it dashed.
pill.leaveTip: Take your character out of the fight; the outcome is written back to the sheet.
pill.removeSeated: {{name}} is a player's character: only its player can leave the table, which is what carries the fight's outcome back to the sheet.

add.hint: Picking a creature seats it at the table and puts it in the order.

table.sitHint: Bring your character to the table.

missing.title: No table yet
missing.body: The DM has not opened this campaign's table.

quarantined.title: The table cannot be read
quarantined.body: This table was written by a newer version of the app. Nothing has been changed.

error.title: The table is out of reach
error.body: The connection dropped. The last thing you saw is still what the table held.

refused.control: That creature is not yours to move.
refused.turn: It is not that creature's turn.
refused.movement: That is further than the creature can still move.

cr.hint: How dangerous a creature is, from 0 upward. It is what an encounter's difficulty is built from.

ac.label: Armour Class (AC)
ac.hint: The number an attack roll has to reach to hit this creature.

slots.label: Spell slots
slots.hint: One diamond per slot, by level. A filled diamond is still yours to spend; a hollow one is gone until you rest.

notice.standFailed: You are still at the table: leaving writes the fight back to your sheet, and that needs a connection.
notice.sitFailed: You could not be seated. Check the connection and try again.
notice.addFailed: That creature could not be added. Check the connection and try again.
notice.openFailed: The table could not be opened. Check the connection and try again.
